description: Robinhood MCP scanner presets for investingRobinhood. scan_id values are account-specific — refresh via get_scans if missing.
setupNote: On first run or if scans empty: create_scan per preset below, then update scan_id fields.

qualityFilters.note: Xu filter: listed stock, not a penny that can go to zero. Retail names OK. Reject chase/extension in ranking, not here.

scans.title: investingRH-earnings-14d
scans.purpose: Discovery only. After AVGO, NEW BUY still requires verified Q exactly 7 calendar days (fund-mandate entryUniverse min=7 max=7). Hits with Q <7d or >7d are not new buys.

scans.title: investingRH-daily-movers
scans.purpose: Macro context — top % movers; filter by qualityFilters before thesis work

scans.title: investingRH-oversold-quality
scans.purpose: Dip entries in quality names — create on first session if scan_id null

workflow.ensureScans: get_scans → if missing, create_scan from presets → update scan_id in this file
